package.digestSource: Equal to the release asset digest GitHub publishes for rust-v0.164.0.

companions.role: Runs the exec tool's JavaScript isolate; required by every tool scenario of the census (findings C8).

claims.notes: Run against the extracted release package: bin/codex beside bin/codex-code-mode-host. Every scenario met its declared expectations; a degraded run writes nothing to the capture directory.

claims.harness: probes/codex@0.164.0: parse-probe.mjs, config-probe.mjs, file-change-probe.mjs, history-truncation-probe.mjs, ema-auth-probe.mjs, and packages/adapter-codex/src/launch/invocation-probe.live.test.ts with live-cases.json
claims.notes: Session-free parse and config-loader probes, root and resume help, the runtime meaning of FileUpdateChange.diff per kind, the 64 KiB command-output cap in replayed history, what config/read and the mcp commands make of an auth = "ema_auth" server without an account, and the S1-S35 invocation landing re-measured in isolated homes against a loopback model.

Digest-pinned exact-release source establishes the kind-dependent meaning of FileUpdateChange.diff, move suffix encoding, and deterministic path ordering; source alone does not prove runtime occurrence.

limitations: Artifact integrity and the hermetic census are pinned for darwin-arm64; darwin-x64, linux-x64 and windows-x64 package artifacts still require independent acquisition and verification.

The exec tool needs the package's codex-code-mode-host beside bin/codex. The artifact identity digests bin/codex; the companion digest is recorded here and in the census run, but the acquisition schema has no companion-file concept yet (findings C8).

The reviewed 0.150.0 behavior graph is retained for established flows and extended with the file-change and history-hydration branches the 0.164.0 census observed; other schema-only methods remain unverified until dedicated runtime scenarios establish their ordering.
History scenarios run on one connection with the thread loaded; a cold resume from the rollout after an app-server restart is not part of the census.
